# Grass Roots Farmers' Cooperative

> Direct-to-consumer grass-fed and pasture-raised meat delivery service offering premium beef, pork, chicken, and lamb with curated sampler boxes and bulk value options.

Grass Roots Farmers' Cooperative specializes in sustainably-raised, regenerative farm meats delivered online. The platform features a comprehensive product catalog organized by meat type, with popular sampler boxes, value bundles, and specialty meal kits designed for health-conscious consumers seeking whole-animal, pasture-raised proteins.

## Key Topics

- Grass-fed beef
- Pasture-raised chicken
- Regenerative farming
- Farm-to-table

- Filet Mignon
- Grass-fed ribeye steak
- Farmers' cooperative
- Online meat delivery

- Whole-animal products
- Pasture-raised pork
- Boneless cuts
- Butcher cuts

## Shop by Meat Type

- [Grass-Fed Beef](https://grassrootscoop.com/collections/grass-fed-beef): Grass-fed beef collection with premium cuts and value boxes

- [Grass-Fed Ground Beef, Sausages & Bison](https://grassrootscoop.com/collections/beef-bison-ground-sausage): Grass-fed ground beef, bison, and sausage products
- [Grass-Fed Beef Ribs](https://grassrootscoop.com/collections/grass-fed-beef-ribs): Grass-fed beef back ribs and short ribs from pasture-raised cattle
- [Pasture Raised Chicken](https://grassrootscoop.com/collections/pastured-chicken): Non-GMO pasture-raised chicken products and whole birds
- [Whole Chicken Parts](https://grassrootscoop.com/collections/whole-chicken-parts): Pasture-raised chicken parts, breasts, and tenders
- [Ground Chicken & Sausages](https://grassrootscoop.com/collections/pastured-ground-chicken-and-sausage): Ground chicken and breakfast sausage links from pasture-raised birds
- [Chicken Organs & Offal](https://grassrootscoop.com/collections/pastured-chicken-offal): Nutrient-dense chicken organs and whole-animal products
